nodes.subtitle: BanditRLProof.RL.FiniteHorizonAdaptiveCumulativeEpisodewiseRealizedBehaviorConsistency
nodes.description: This module sharpens the finite-window realized-return route by preserving the iid structure inside each generated batch.
